name: Takei Yuki
source:
She used to be a professional female shogi player.

She has left the world of Shogi due to lack of physical strength, but she still has some unfulfilled dreams.

She and her husband have a broken marriage, and are simply together for appearance sakes.

She likes sex very much, but she doesn't tell her husband.
